flashback.speaker: Nenek
flashback.text: Nenek lagi duduk-duduk aja, kamu mau dengar cerita?

events.introText: A cat bursts in and knocks your things over!

tutorial.title: Event: Naughty Cat
tutorial.text: A cat suddenly runs in and knocks over things you already tidied. You cannot stop it: tidy the scattered things again (drag them back where they belong). It can happen again.

flashback.speaker: Narator
flashback.text: Aroma masakan yang harum semerbak memenuhi dapur.

flashback.speaker: MC kecil
flashback.text: Nenek! Aku tadi- wihh wangi banget! Nenek masak apa?

flashback.speaker: MC kecil
flashback.text: Pastinya mau dong nek! Aku bantu nenek siapin alat makannya ya?

flashback.speaker: Nenek
flashback.text: Iya, hati-hati bawa piringnya nanti jatuh.

events.introText: A sudden downpour! Water is seeping in and flooding the floor.

tutorial.title: Event: Downpour
tutorial.text: Heavy rain floods the floor. Follow the arrows to each puddle and clean it with the Mop (hold 2). It can happen again.

events.introText: Power cut! Place candles (hold 5, release on the floor) so you can see.

tutorial.title: Event: Power Cut
tutorial.text: The room goes dark and you can only clean where it is lit. Hold 5 (or hold the Candle slot) and release on the floor to place a candle. You can place more than one. Candles burn out, so place new ones. Staying in the dark too long grows more cobwebs.

events.introText: A cockroach! Click it to keep cleaning.

tutorial.title: Event: Cockroach
tutorial.text: A cockroach blocks your cleaning. Follow the arrow and click the running cockroach to catch it.

flashback.speaker: MC kecil
flashback.text: Kalau {mc} udah besar, nanti aku mau kerja.

flashback.speaker: MC kecil
flashback.text: Terus uangnya bisa beli obat biar nenek bisa sembuh.

flashback.speaker: Nenek
flashback.text: (terkekeh) Iya iya, kalau udah kerja jangan lupa jenguk nenek ya.

flashback.speaker: MC kecil
flashback.text: Aku ga bakal lupa kok! Aku janji nek!

events.introText: A gale blows the window open! Click the window again and again to shut it!

tutorial.title: Event: Gale
tutorial.text: The wind throws the window open! Click the window again and again until it shuts (watch the bar on the event card). While it is open the wind blows tidied things around, brings in dust and dirties cleaned spots again, and it gets worse over time.
